notes: 0.4.0 多端通用 + WebDAV：Windows 走 PowerShell（.cmd + runtime/*.ps1），macOS/Linux 走 Node 引擎（.sh + runtime/sync-engine.mjs）；平台差异收敛在 runtime/platform.mjs，业务代码不再出现 process.platform 分支。新增 WebDAV 通道（与 git 共用同一份仓库格式，只换传输层，无三方合并、冲突本机留底 .conflict-<时间戳>）。跨端不分叉仓库：配置/技能/会话只有一份，客户端身份记在仓库 machines/<id>.json，host-contract.json 增加 platforms[] 并集。包名改为 dsh-profile-config-sync。
notesEn: 0.4.0 adds multi-platform support and WebDAV: Windows uses PowerShell (.cmd + runtime/*.ps1), macOS/Linux use the Node engine (.sh + runtime/sync-engine.mjs); platform differences live in runtime/platform.mjs so business code has no process.platform branches. New WebDAV transport reuses the same repo format as git (no three-way merge; conflicting local files are kept as .conflict-<timestamp>). The repo is not forked per OS: configs, skills and sessions stay single-copy, client identity is recorded in machines/<id>.json, and host-contract.json gains a platforms[] union. Package renamed to dsh-profile-config-sync.
